# Sarah-cat

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Sarah-cat is a large, sleek, gray-and-white cat. She carries herself with an enormous dignity that remains unaffected by her plebeian origin.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah-cat is an eight-year-old who possesses remarkable skill as a mouser.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

The Sarah-cat was originally given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by her washerwoman and named by Aunt Jamesina's husband. She was brought to Patty's Place when [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) moved in to chaperone [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends. After an initial adjustment period marked by turf wars and squabbles with the resident cat [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the Sarah-cat successfully established her dominance over him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), +4 more_

## Relationships

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--sarah-cat.md)

The Sarah-cat and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) are household pets who live together under the care of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), eventually moving with her to Patty's Place. Upon their arrival, both cats undergo an adjustment period alongside the resident cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). While [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) ultimately accepts the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat's dominance, he becomes close friends with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +6 more_
